answer: Mechanism: per-epoch identity tickets require burning a fixed quartz-denominated bond plus a cedar-attested liveness check; payouts follow a concave function of aggregate bonded stake per controller, capped at the reward curve’s nadir. Attacker cost scales with bond and attestation per fake ID. Splitting stake across IDs cannot raise total payout because concavity makes two half-stakes pay less than one full stake. Limitation: colluders with genuine attestations or stolen credentials can pool
